transcript.text: Good morning, it's Vega here! It may be time for your medication. Have you already taken it?

I don't understand any of this
I understand this can be a bit confusing. Let's take it one step at a time. Could you please check your medication box to see if today's dose has been taken?
I'm still here if you need any assistance. Could you let me know if you've been able to check your medication box to see if today's dose has been taken?
